title: Self-Supervised Noise2Noise-Enhanced Denoising for Continuous-Scan Air-Plasma THz Spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2608.16454v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) based on air-plasma generation and balanced air-biased coherent detection offers gap-free broadband coverage, but individual continuous-scan traces are strongly affected by pulse-to-pulse fluctuations and electronic noise. Reaching a useful signal-to-noise ratio therefore requires averaging multiple traces, which directly increases measurement time. We propose a learned denoising approach that recovers high-quality THz waveforms from as few as one complete continuous delay sweep, referred to here as a single-scan trace. A compact one-dimensional residual U-Net is trained using two complementary strategies: a reference-supervised baseline that maps individual noisy traces to long-average reference waveforms, and a Noise2Noise approach that learns from pairs of independently acquired noisy traces without requiring a clean training target. translated_title: 基于自监督Noise2Noise增强去噪的连续扫描空气等离子体太赫兹光谱技术
translated_abstract: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）基于空气等离子体产生和平衡空气偏置相干检测，提供了无间隙的宽带覆盖，但单个连续扫描轨迹受到脉冲间波动和电子噪声的强烈影响。因此，要达到有用的信噪比需要对多个轨迹进行平均，这直接增加了测量时间。我们提出了一种学习去噪方法，能从最少一个完整的连续延迟扫描（此处称为单扫描轨迹）中恢复高质量太赫兹波形。一个紧凑的一维残差U-Net使用两种互补策略进行训练：一种参考监督基线，将单个噪声轨迹映射到长平均参考波形；以及一种Noise2Noise方法，从独立获取的噪声轨迹对中学习，无需干净的训练目标。对两个模型的预测进行平均可减少系统误差并提高整体性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自监督Noise2Noise增强的去噪方法，能从单个连续扫描轨迹中恢复高质量太赫兹波形，显著减少测量时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised Noise2Noise-enhanced denoising method that recovers high-quality terahertz waveforms from a single continuous-scan trace, significantly reducing measurement time.
